flags.purpose: List all event logs including custom and hidden logs.
flags.threat_detected: Custom logs used for staging data or tracking activity.
flags.safe_followup: Query logs with qe; inspect config with gl.

flags.security_use_case: Investigate logons, process creation, privilege use.
flags.safe_followup: Export results; widen query time range if needed.

flags.purpose: Get detailed log information including record count and last write time.
flags.security_use_case: Check whether logs were recently cleared or tampered.
flags.threat_detected: Sudden drop in record count indicating log clearing.

flags.example_command: wevtutil gl Security | findstr /i "enabled logpath maxsize"
flags.purpose: View log configuration such as size, path, retention.
flags.threat_detected: Small log size causing overwrite of evidence.
flags.safe_followup: Increase size using sl if required.

flags.purpose: Export logs for preservation and analysis.
flags.security_use_case: Preserve evidence before log rotation or tampering.
flags.risk_if_misused: Sensitive data exposure if stored insecurely.
flags.safe_followup: Analyze with SIEM or offline tools.

flags.purpose: Clear all events from a log.
flags.security_use_case: Rare maintenance action only after backup.
flags.threat_detected: Attackers clearing logs to hide traces (Event ID 1102).
flags.safe_followup: Always export with epl before clearing.

flags.purpose: Set log size and retention behavior.

flags.safe_followup: Use XML for tooling and scripts.
Increase count or filter by time.

powerful_combinations.command: wevtutil qe Security /q:"*[System[(EventID=4624 or EventID=4625 or EventID=4672 or EventID=4688)]]" /c:500 /rd:true /f:text
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Shows logons, failures, privilege use, and process creation together.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Rapid detection of compromise and privilege escalation.

powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Detects when Security log was cleared.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Strong indicator of attacker anti-forensics activity.

powerful_combinations.command: for /f %i in ('wevtutil el') do @wevtutil gl %i | findstr /i "enabled maxsize logpath" & echo ===
powerful_combinations.why_powerful: Inventory of all log configurations on the system.
powerful_combinations.security_context: Find weak log retention settings across logs.

powerful_combinations.command: wevtutil epl Security C:\Forensics\Security.evtx && wevtutil epl System C:\Forensics\System.evtx && wevtutil epl Application C:\Forensics\Application.evtx
powerful_combinations.security_context: First response step during incident handling.
